correctness.rationale: The avoidance language is factorial and its counts are submultiplicative, so their exponential growth rate is the survivor entropy. Entropy minimality makes the gap positive when the survivor is nonempty, while compactness forces eventual emptiness when it is empty. The empty word realizes the global avoidance ratio inside each follower/predecessor supremum; the bi-balance lower bound on every follower/predecessor denominator gives the matching upper constant factor. For an invariant Gibbs measure, each conditional cylinder ratio is bounded by the quotient of the Gibbs estimates, and the empty history supplies the matching lower bound. The claim correctly excludes occurrences straddling the conditioning boundary.
